title: The Wish Series
narrativeSpine: Four distinct realities test desire becoming available, keeping ordinary compromises alongside changes that appear to make the world responsive.
firstSceneDraft: The Wish Series gathers four stories about desire, choice, and altered reality.
Its opening follows a commuter whose ordinary compromise precedes extraordinary good fortune.
A world that answers wishes can change the meaning of responsibility.
The collection gives that tension several lives instead of one universal example.
visualActionProposal: A commuter’s closing train door and a new wealth notification occupy the same moment; later four divergent rooms retain different personal costs.
